annotations.title: Prepare inference funding from creator fees

description: Prepare unsigned transactions that turn part of a QHooks launch creator's fee earnings into Orbio inference: release() on each of the wallet's Robinhood Chain launch income contracts with a pending share, then the prepare_credit_topup flow for pct of the wallet's own share of the pending quote currency (WETH is unwrapped to ETH first). Returns status below_dust and no transactions when the share is under minUsd. Run it on a schedule; never signs or sends.

chain.description: Robinhood Chain (4663), where Orbio CREDIT trades.

minUsd.description: Dust floor for the amount to fund, in USD. Default 0.5.

pct.description: Percent of the wallet's claimable quote-currency share to turn into CREDIT. Default: the fundInferencePct saved on the wallet's QHooks agent profile.

slippageBps.description: Slippage for the ETH->USDG swap and the CREDIT minimum, in basis points. Default 100.

sources.description: Optional launch income contract addresses. Default: found from the wallet's QHooks launches.

name: prepare_fund_inference
